failure_policy: All four invented technical controls must return strict valid stage1 output with punctuation-only invariance. Any failure blocks development cases and leaves all20 pending. Stage1 case errors or invalid invariance reuse exact baseline without a stage2 rerun; valid byte-identical sources also reuse baseline. Changed accepted source gets one original-prompt translation; stage2 errors remain failures without retry.
review_policy: No rubric, reference, or grade in model requests. Independent meaning review uses the unchanged frozen rubric; exact reused outputs may reuse frozen grades. Same-decoding baseline is 13 passes; separately report historical best sampled 14; no production promotion. Candidate merits fresh validation only if it beats13 with zero baseline-pass regressions; more than14 needed to exceed historical best.
timing_policy: Sequential CPU8; controls/startup/warmup excluded. Fallback/unchanged cost includes stage1 plus historical measured baseline. Exact pristine-cache hit includes stage1 plus historical translation timing. Otherwise cost is stage1 plus new stage2. No live-speed estimate.
